methods: recursive ZIP and ZIP HTTP response scan
PNG SHA deduplication and tesseract stdin/stdout psm11 OCR
manual classification of allowed generic runtime paths and official public assets
limits: Non-UTF8 payloads have no text-only privacy claim. PNG payloads were OCR scanned; ZIP bytes were preserved exactly.
Virtual session/Run/execution UUIDs, nonce values, worker identities and local PIDs are test evidence, not physical-device serial or MAC identifiers.
